title: Mendero Group expands healthcare reach in Northern Cebu with new radiology center, mobile clinic

blocks.text: Mendero Medical Center – Cebu launched its new Mendero Radiology Center and Mobile Clinic on September 25, 2026 in Consolacion, Cebu, expanding its diagnostic and community healthcare services for patients in Northern Cebu. Led by Mendero Group President and CEO Dr. Samuel Mendero III, the dual launch introduced upgraded imaging capabilities, including a 128-slice CT scanner, Digital X-Ray, General Ultrasound, and Obstetrics and Gynecologic Ultrasound, alongside a Mobile Clinic designed to provide healthcare services directly to communities. The development comes as Mendero continues to strengthen its role in Northern Cebu, where a significant portion of its patients already come from communities […]...
